item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30699

🇷🇺
🇺🇿
Andrei Belousov: cooperation between defence agencies of two countries reaches high level and continues to expand
Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Andrei Belousov held talks with the Minister of Defence of the Republic of Uzbekistan Major General Botir Kudratkhodjayev as part of a working visit to Uzbekistan.
'The cooperation between the defence agencies of the two countries has reached a high level and continues to expand. Nowadays, this is especially important for strengthening overall security in the Central Asian region,' said Andrei Belousov.
💬
Andrei Belousov stressed that Russia and Uzbekistan
are partners and long-standing friends,
and the main vector of their interaction is determined by warm and friendly relations between the presidents of the two countries.
'Currently, we are implementing the Strategic Partnership Programme in Military Sphere for 2026–2030. In accordance with it, we hold more than 60 events annually. Particular attention is paid to operational and combat training of troops and joint exercises. In October, Russian and Uzbek troops practised joint missions at the Termez training ground,' the Russian Defence Minister noted.
▫️
The head of the Russian defence department added that
personnel training and regular consultations on the activities of the armed forces are another important areas of bilateral cooperation.
'We attach great importance to the training of Uzbek servicemen in our special training centres of the Russian Armed Forces, as well as to comprehensive exercises and training sessions led by Russian instructors with real combat experience,' he said.
📊
Andrei Belousov noted that the Russian defence department is aimed at further active cooperation to increase the combat potential of the Armed Forces of the Republic of Uzbekistan and ensure collective security.
🤝
In turn, Major General Botir Kudratkhodjayev conveyed words of welcome from the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan.
'Thanks to the political will of the heads of our states, the relations between Russia and Uzbekistan have moved to a qualitatively new level. It should be noted that today, there is positive development of cooperation in the military field,' he noted.
🌐
The head of the Uzbek Defence Ministry stressed that
Uzbekistan is interested in further expanding bilateral cooperation
with Russia in the field of defence and ensuring regional security.
✅
At the end of the talks, the
sides signed the 2027 Cooperation Plan
between the Ministry of Defence of the Russian Federation and the Ministry of Defence of the Republic of Uzbekistan.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30695

❗️
Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out a massive strike
with ground-, sea-, air-based high-precision weapons, unmanned aerial vehicles against enterprises of the Ukrainian defence industry, warehouses, power facilities, transport and port infrastructure, as well as vessels used in the interests of the AFU.
💥
As a result of the strikes,
the following targets were hit:
📍
in Kiev and Kiev region:
▪️
a manufacturing enterprise of explosives and powder (state powder metallurgy plant) in Brovary,
which produces components of solid missile fuel for FP-9 operational-tactical missiles;
▪️
a UAV assembly enterprise
that prepares fixed-wing UAVs;
▪️
road and rail bridges
used for the transit of AFU weapons, military and special hardware to the combat operations zone in Donbass;
▪️
the assembly plant (Fire Point LLC) in Petrovskoye,
which assembles, prepares for combat use, and delivers FP-7 Flamingo cruise missiles to launch sites;
📍
in Dnepropetrovsk region:
▪️
the PS-330 Terny-Pervomayskaya electric substation in Terny,
which distributes electricity to support the operation of defence industry enterprises and military facilities of the AFU in Dnepropetrovsk region;
📍
in Chernigov region:
▪️
the PS-110 electric substation in Mena,
which distributes electricity to ensure the operation of enterprises of the defence industry and military facilities of the AFU in Chernigov region;
📍
in Ivano-Frankovsk region:
▪️
the Burshtynskaya thermal power plant in the village of Burshtyn
, which produces electricity, including for the operation of enterprises of the Ukrainian defence industry and military facilities of the AFU;
📍
in Lvov region:
▪️
the Lvov aviation industry repair facility (Lvov State Aviation Repair Plant)
, which produces FP-9 tactical missiles and FP-5 Flamingo cruise missiles, as well as long- and medium-range unmanned aerial vehicles;
▪️
the PS-750 Zapadnoukrainskaya electric substation in Khodorov
, which distributes electricity to support the operation of the defence industry and military facilities of the AFU in Lvov region;
📍
in Nikolayev region:
▪️
a depot in Bereznegovatoye
, where cruise missiles are stored and used to hit civilian objects in the Russian Federation;
📍
in Odessa region:
▪️
the Zatoka road bridge
used for the transit of military goods by road and rail.
🔥
In addition, a dry cargo ship delivering military cargo
to the port of Odessa
at sea
, as well as
three railway locomotives near Dnepropetrovsk station, and one locomotive near Korosten station of Zhitomir region,
used to transport freight trains with military and dual-use cargo for the AFU, were hit.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
